about: Version-preferred mine designs: each preset is a list of template steps (MineTemplates.cs / mineTemplates.ts) on the 64x64 plot, in absolute world y. A design made from one is saved with 'preferred_for <version>'. top 'surface' = the highest ground over the shaft's square on the session's terrain.

presets.name: 1.12.2 diamond strip mine at y 11
presets.notes: A 4x4 spiral shaft from the surface to a landing at y 11, then a 1x2 main corridor east with 1x2 branches 4 blocks apart on both sides. The layout study (docs/design/mine-blueprints.md, 40 seeds of the studio terrain) found this the most diamonds per block dug: branches 4 apart find about 1.2 diamonds per 100 blocks mined (3 apart 1.16, 2 apart 0.96), and a 2x3 corridor digs 10% more for 3% more ore. y 11 is the lowest level above the lava lakes (y 10 and below) and inside the diamond, redstone and gold bands.

presets.name: 1.12.2 diamond strip mine at y 11, thorough
presets.notes: The same mine with branches 2 blocks apart: every block between two branches touches one, so it strips the area clean. It digs about 70% more than the 4-apart mine for about 30% more ore: use it when the plot, not the digging, is what is scarce.

presets.name: 1.12.2 lapis and iron strip mine at y 16
presets.notes: Lapis is most common around y 14-16 and iron is spread evenly below y 64: a 3x3 spiral (1x1 core) down to y 16, then 1x2 branches 4 apart (the study's best ore per block dug; iron finds the most per block at y 16).

presets.name: b1.8.1 diamond strip mine at y 11
presets.notes: Beta 1.8.1's ore veins are one block smaller, but measured on the studio terrain branches 4 apart still find the most diamonds per block dug (about 1.05 per 100 blocks mined; 2 apart 0.85): smaller veins are missed a little more often, not enough to pay for twice the digging. y 11 is above the lava lakes and inside the diamond, redstone and gold bands (y 10-12 measure the same).

presets.name: b1.8.1 diamond strip mine at y 11, thorough
presets.notes: The same mine with branches 2 blocks apart: every block between two branches touches one, so it strips the area clean. It digs about 70% more than the 4-apart mine for about 30% more ore: use it when the plot, not the digging, is what is scarce.

presets.name: b1.8.1 lapis and gold strip mine at y 16
presets.notes: Lapis peaks at y 16 and gold sits below y 32: a 3x3 spiral (1x1 core) down to y 16, then 1x2 branches 4 apart (the study's best ore per block dug).
